Pune hatchback tyre replacement

Shortlist these 3 providers for a city-driven hatchback. Get an all-inclusive quote for your exact tyre size.

TyresNmore

Doorstep fitting • Ghorpadi, Pune

Convenient for home replacement; ask for fitting, balancing and alignment bundled.

Tyre Trax

Bridgestone Select • Baner

Good option for comparing branded tyres and authorised-dealer support.

Sai Enterprises

Baner • Multi-brand tyre dealer

Useful for comparing Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone and Yokohama quotes.

Costs and terms to check

Budget: Roughly ₹17,000–₹24,500 for four hatchback tyres in Pune, before confirming your exact size and package. 
Ride N Repair Blog

Ask for a written total: tyres + GST, fitting, valves, balancing, alignment, disposal and any doorstep fee.

Confirm tyre manufacturing date, warranty, puncture/damage coverage and whether old tyres are exchanged.

Before paying, check cancellation/refund rules: whether unused tyres can be returned, fitting-fee refunds, delivery delays, and whether fitted tyres are non-returnable.

Best next step: Share your car model and tyre size (e.g. 175/65 R15). I can narrow this to three exact tyre options and realistic totals.

For a Vadodara factory, I’d shortlist these three PPE combinations:

Udyogi Ultra/Fusion helmet + nitrile gloves — ~₹125–230/helmet; ~₹130–200/glove. Good general-purpose choice. Look for IS 2925 helmet certification and EN 388-rated gloves. 
sameeksha.net

Karam PN521 helmet + ProKut cut-resistant gloves — ~₹195–350/helmet; ~₹280–310/glove. Better for fabrication, sheet-metal or engineering work. PN521 has ratchet adjustment and chin strap. 
ganeshchhaya.com

VALPRO Ranger helmet + PU-coated cut-resistant gloves — ~₹119/helmet; ~₹70–200/glove. Budget-oriented option for large workforces. 
aasurti.com

What to check: ISI/BIS marking (IS 2925), impact resistance, 6-point suspension, ratchet fit and chin strap. For gloves, match EN 388 ratings to actual cut/abrasion risks, plus grip and chemical/heat resistance where required.
